providers.name: OneMap Search API (Singapore Land Authority)
providers.cost: Official workshop describes APIs as free-to-use.
providers.match_coverage: Search endpoint accepts postal code; returns WGS84 latitude and longitude with address details. Potentially applicable to the 2,442 exact six-digit postals; each result must be checked for exact POSTAL equality and valid coordinates. The remaining 102 records need address/name research or must remain blank.
providers.persistence_and_rights: API Terms state datasets are governed by Singapore Open Data Licence. SODL v1.0 permits copying, modifying, adapting and distributing datasets or derived analyses/apps, with conspicuous source/date attribution and link to current licence. Third-party rights/personal data exclusions apply.
providers.rate_and_access: Current endpoint docs require Authorization token and document HTTP 429 when API limit is exceeded. Official OneMap workshop states token-based APIs have a 300 calls/minute limit. Conservative client should pace below 300/min, use one worker, cache by postal code, checkpoint and retry 429s. 2,442 unique postal lookups require at least 8.14 minutes at the published ceiling; operationally allow longer.
providers.precision_limit: Building/postal centroid or building address point, not a restaurant entrance, unit, or stall-front pin. Preserve source and label Coordinate Precision accordingly; never imply storefront precision.
providers.current_execution_status: No bulk or sample API request made. ONEMAP_API_TOKEN is absent in this shell, so live authorization and current token validity are unverified. User previously stated token expiry date 2026-10-19; expiry time/renewal status unknown.
providers.recommendation: Preferred free persistent source for postal-coded blanks, once a valid token is configured securely. Process unique postals only; cache results; exact-postal match; manually hold multi-result/no-result/ambiguous matches; leave non-postal rows blank pending higher-confidence official address source.

providers.name: OpenStreetMap public Nominatim
providers.cost: Public service is free, community-hosted, best-effort.
providers.match_coverage: Potentially useful for hand-reviewed mapped businesses, but postal coverage and feature completeness are not guaranteed; weak for 2,442 systematic postal lookups.
providers.persistence_and_rights: Nominatim policy says data is ODbL and attribution is required; ODbL share-alike obligations may apply to the resulting database. Review ODbL obligations before mixing results into a distributed catalogue.
providers.rate_and_access: Absolute maximum 1 request/second; bulk geocoding of larger amounts is discouraged. Policy expressly forbids systematic queries such as searching for complete lists of postcodes/towns; requires a single thread, one machine, caching, and tighter limits for long-running/repeated scripts.
providers.recommendation: Do not use the public Nominatim endpoint for this systematic postal backfill. Self-hosted OSM data/geocoder could be evaluated separately, but would have nontrivial setup and incomplete postal/address coverage.

decision: OneMap is the suitable free source for persistent building/postal coordinates, subject to valid token configuration, exact returned-postal validation, proper SODL attribution, conservative rate control, and explicit building-level precision. No Mapbox Search Box calls and no external API requests were made for this research.
